opening.argument: The video reviews Crypto.com as an exchange where viewers can set up a verified account, buy cryptocurrency, and consider advertised Earn rates. It describes the ID check before purchases and shows annual rates for several assets. The speaker also warns that investing is risky and explicitly distinguishes Crypto.com from OneCoin and USI-Tech, which he calls Ponzi schemes. The separate invitation to a free online-business workshop does not change the subject of that review. The stated interest rates warrant scrutiny, but neither those rates nor the earnings dashboard establishes fraud by this reviewer. The observable presentation is a review of a cryptocurrency service with a risk warning, not evidence of losses or a fraudulent outcome.
